help.heading: How can we help?
help.subtitle: Use our support channels or the frequently asked questions section for your questions.

faqs.question: How can I add a new account?
faqs.answer: To add a new account, go to the "Accounts" page and tap the + button in the bottom right corner. Enter your account details on the page that opens and tap the "Save" button.

faqs.question: How can I create a category?
faqs.answer: To create a new category, go to "Settings" > "Categories" and tap the + button in the bottom right corner. Choose a category name, icon, and color, then tap the "Save" button.

faqs.question: How can I back up the app?
faqs.answer: To back up your data, go to "Settings" > "Backup" and tap "Create Backup". You can save the backup file somewhere like Drive and bring it back on a new phone with "Restore from Backup". Your data is stored only on this device; there is no automatic backup.

faqs.question: How can I filter transactions?
faqs.answer: On the transactions page, tap the filter icon at the top to filter by date, category, account, or amount.

faqs.question: How can I create a budget goal?
faqs.answer: To create a budget goal, go to "Settings" > "Budget Goals" and tap the "+" button. Enter the category, amount, and time range to create a budget goal.

faqs.question: I forgot my password, what should I do?
faqs.answer: To reset your password, tap "Forgot Password" on the login screen. Enter your email address and you will receive an email with password reset instructions.
